sources.prompt:
Game asset atlas, exact blue slate stone style and elevated frontal camera of the reference. GENUINE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. NINE independent complete modular sprites in a strict3x3 grid, wide clear gutters. No room, no half-room, no connected frame. Each slot is an individual reusable construction piece.
Canvas1800x1800, each slot600x600. All pieces share the SAME stone scale, light direction and camera. Quiet hand-painted blue-grey stone, soft edges, not shiny crystals. Horizontal wall tops are foreshortened into shallow bands. All upright faces face toward screen bottom. No isometric axes or converging perspective.
ROW1:
left NORTHWEST OUTER CORNER ONLY. One solid L-shaped masonry turn: a short arm exits right and a short arm exits down. Its top surface visibly turns90degrees. A short darker north-wall inner facade descends under the horizontal arm. No separate post, no ornament, no tall pillar. Natural flush open connection ends, not terminal caps. Draw this corner as one coherent volume.
middle NORTH STRAIGHT WALL: one repeatable horizontal wall module about320px wide x180px total height. Light cap band about60px deep; dark upright inner face below120px with two staggered rows. NO pillars or end posts. Left/right ends are flush open masonry joints so copies can join.
right NORTHEAST OUTER CORNER: same construction as NW, arm left and arm down. Coherent L top and matching north inner facade.
ROW2:
left WEST STRAIGHT WALL TOP CORE: a narrow96px wide x200px tall vertical band of two contiguous elongated flat top stones. Same camera, not a side-facing upright facade, no thick repeated south lips, no pedestal, no end face at either end. Only a restrained thin darker inner edge on right. No external backing.
middle FLOOR: one flat horizontal paving slab about320px wide x200px deep, visibly foreshortened by the SAME elevated camera. Low contrast soft blue-grey stone. Tiny worn corners, thin mortar edge, no raised bevel, no thick front face, no big crack, not a square icon.
right EAST STRAIGHT WALL TOP CORE: same96x200 band, restrained inner edge on left, NO backing or end face.
ROW3:
left SOUTHWEST OUTER CORNER ONLY: cap surface forms a solid90degree L, short arms UP and RIGHT. This is a TURN not a post. The horizontal cap joins the side cap at the same level with a visible continuous elbow. Below the cap a darker upright SOUTH-facing exterior face descends120px. Its cap depth is60px exactly like the south straight wall. No vertical diamond or oversized pillar. Plain coherent masonry, flush connection ends.
middle SOUTH STRAIGHT WALL: same320x180 module as north, cap depth60 and exterior facade120 beneath it. Staggered dark stone joints, flush left/right ends without posts.
right SOUTHEAST OUTER CORNER ONLY: corresponding corner, arms UP and LEFT. Visible uninterrupted L cap, same height as straight wall, one south-facing exterior face below.
All corner arms are SHORT, about96px from their central elbow; each corner is about192px wide, not an entire room side. They must connect to the above straight pieces with identical cap thickness and facade height. Transparent outside and around every silhouette. NO external dark side backing rows baked into the art: those remain independent engine elements. No floors under wall pieces, no props/torches/door/hearts/effects, no labels, no sheet grid, no atmospheric background, no cast shadow.

Precise correction of this MODULAR SPRITE ATLAS, preserve its layout and native transparency. Keep the same nine separate slots, same blue painted art, top-down frontal camera, approximate sprite sizes, and complete gutter-separated silhouettes. No room assembly.
1) CENTER slot must contain ONE paving slab, not six tiles. One broad flat slate slab with width about500px and depth about290px, low contrast, no raised face, no big crack, native alpha edges. Floor lies horizontally under the same elevated camera; no pixel or square icon.
2) Both BOTTOM CORNER modules must share the bottom straight wall's cap depth and facade height: horizontal TOP CAP about95px deep; beneath it a DARK FRONT FACADE about115px deep made of TWO staggered brick courses. Extend the lower face downward if needed; keep at least35px clear bottom margin. At each corner the upper stone is a genuine L-shaped elbow joining its up-arm and horizontal arm. The upper elbow must be flush with the neighboring straight wall TOP, not with its facade. The rightward/leftward connection cross-section must match the center bottom module, top and foot aligned, with no cut-off horizontal top or tall separate post.
3) TOP CORNER modules also have the same approximately95px cap depth and115px facade beneath their horizontal arms, matching the TOP straight module.
4) Side straight modules at middle left/right: remove the row of small dark backing stones alongside each cap band; leave ONLY the coherent narrow vertical cap band with natural thin outlines, no baked extra row and no large front face at its lower end. Exterior backing is separately added in engine.
Keep both long straight horizontal modules unchanged, same cap and two darker front courses. Keep all corner arms short and reusable, no full side of a room. Never merge modules. No labels, background gradient, effects or added objects. Genuine transparent PNG.

Edit only the two sprites in the bottom LEFT and bottom RIGHT slots. KEEP EVERY OTHER PIXEL/SPRITE/LAYOUT as close as possible. The bottom corner sprites each currently have ONE row of dark front-facing stones below their light L cap. ADD A SECOND dark brick row underneath that existing row, extending both corner sprites DOWN by about55pixels into their currently empty bottom gutters. Their bottoms should end around y=1220 on this1254x1254 sheet. This is an extension of their upright masonry front facade, NOT a step, platform, lip or extra cap. It must be two continuous dark brick courses of the same wall face, like the bottom CENTER sprite. Preserve the corner top stones' original positions. The dark face under the light cap must now have approximately the SAME total height as the dark face under the bottom center straight wall cap. Keep genuine native transparency outside the new contours. Do not touch the other seven sprites or the floor. No background, labels, arrows, glow or outlines added.

note: Only center floor slot from first atlas is used. Single large slab from later atlas is not used. Single logical room cell contains multiple small decorative paving tiles.
